labels.notes: Unmarked, as dispatched: no bold backticked label anywhere in the file, and the label line `bzthm:intro_B` — `benzecri1960_ch1.tex:86` falls within the first 4000 characters. REPORT status is partial, which is correct. Statements were read against the transcription l.81–104 and the scan (PDF p. 4 = journal p. 231). The transcription and the module's `>` quote both match the scan word for word: « s'identifie à », « une projection … dont la fermeture est incluse dans un hémisphère ouvert », « a une projection non bornée ». SENTENCE 1, PROJECTIVE HALF (resultB_poche_proj, resultB_premiere_proj). Pocket ⇒ a compatible chart φ̃ with source univ, so W ≅ the open φ̃(W) as projective manifolds; Lean adds EqOn φ̃ φ P. Shell ⇒ Sphere.IsConvexPart φ̃.target, plus IsStrictConvexPart, which also gives the Minkowski reading (Convex.lean:462). Lean ≥ paper. SENTENCE 2 (resultB_coque_stricte, resultB_hemisphere, resultB_deuxieme). A strict shell, or ANY developing map p with closure(range p) ⊆ H for an open hemisphere H (Déf. 5 as printed, so the degenerate H = ∅ is also admitted, which widens the hypothesis), gives ∃ K, IsCorpsConvexeS n K, and a compatible chart with source univ and target interior K. Reading « projection » as a developing map is Ch. 2 Prop. 2's own wording (« projection p sur S(n) compatible avec la structure projective », ch2 l.719–720). Lean ≥ paper. SENTENCE 3 (resultB_troisieme). (∃ developing p) ∧ ∀ developing p, ¬IsBounded (range p), under [NeZero n]. This is stronger than « a une projection non bornée » for n ≥ 1. The n = 0 restriction is disclosed: checklist « ⚠ strengthened », SCOPE and the finding. GENERAL-COVERING FORM. It assumes only: V charted, compact and T2 (no HasGroupoid, connectedness or second countability); N charted with HasGroupoid and simply connected; π a covering and a GX-morphism. The paper's W with its pulled-back structure satisfies all of this (revetement_universel_divisible_proj/_aff), so the form is at least the paper's universal cover. SPECIALISATION TO UniversalCover V v₀. It is genuine. The pocket, shell and developing-map hypotheses elaborate with the strict global instances UniversalCover.instChartedSpaceProj/Aff and instHasGroupoidProj/Aff (UniversalCoverRow.lean:472–494). The covering, simply-connectedness and morphism facts come from the strict revetement_universel_divisible_proj/_aff. NON-CONNECTED V. W is then the universal cover of v₀'s path component, the convention of UniversalCoverRow (its checklist l.58). This is disclosed in SCOPE and in REPORT questions, and it is fair: it only enlarges the class of V, and the printed forms carry ConnectedSpace and SecondCountableTopology. PRINTED FORMS. ResultBProjPrinted n is exactly sentence 1's projective half (pocket ⇒ chart with source univ; shell ⇒ convex target) plus sentence 2's two clauses, over V : Type that is T2, connected, second countable and compact. That is the printed result B minus the affine half of sentence 1 and minus sentence 3, which ResultBTroisiemePrinted carries. resultBProjPrinted is proved for every n. FINDING. Sentence 3 is false at n = 0. Verified: in ℝ⁰ every range is bounded (resultB_isBounded_dim_zero), so the literal « ∃ an unbounded projection » fails as well as the Lean ∀ form. resultBTroisiemePrinted_iff (↔ 0 < n) is fair; its witness V = Fin 0 → ℝ satisfies every hypothesis of the printed form. It is OQ-45 (a)'s question, recorded with no new OQ, consistent with projectionNonBorneePrinted_iff (Prop. 1, ch2 l.648–654). The closing gloss l.100–104 is not formalised. It is disclosed in SCOPE; that SCOPE bullet is the post-build edit.

checks.t2_lemma: resultB_t2Space_of_isCoveringMap is correct. Same fibre: IsCoveringMap.isSeparatedMap; different fibres: preimages of disjoint opens. Mathlib at fabf563a has no direct lemma. It has t2space_iff_isSeparatedMap and IsSeparatedMap.comp_left/comp_right, but no composition of two separated maps and no IsCoveringMap.t2Space, so isSeparatedMap already is the most direct route and the proof is minimal. It is a verbatim copy of lean-gx's t2Space_of_isCoveringMap (GX/Branched/Universality.lean:249). DEC-112's layering rule forbids importing GX, so the copy is acceptable, and it is cited. Neither the strict library nor the sibling scaffold files have a twin. Candidate for UniversalCoverRow at a later curation.
checks.non_vacuity: resultB_nonVacuite_hopf: V = ]0,∞[/2^ℤ. The kernel checks that V is compact (via the fundamental domain [1,2]), T2 (Mathlib's quotient instance under ProperlyDiscontinuousSMul, LocallyCompactSpace and T2Space), and locally projective (ChartedSpace pinned by letI to MulAction.instChartedSpaceQuotient, HasGroupoid from hasGroupoid_quotient). It also checks that π is a covering and a GX-morphism and that ]0,∞[ is simply connected. The witness has a strict shell P ≠ univ, so the cote is non-constant (z ≡ 0 forces P = V). The hemisphere hypothesis is satisfied by the compatible chart φ̃, whose source is univ, so φ̃ is a developing map. Non-degenerate. It instantiates the general-covering form, not UniversalCover itself, and the REPORT says so. That is enough, because the UniversalCover forms are one-line specialisations through the strict revetement_universel_divisible_proj, and every simply connected covering is homeomorphic over V to UniversalCover (UniversalCover.exists_homeomorph_of_simplyConnected). See the wording point on S(0) under findings. resultB_troisieme_hopf: S(m) × S¹ with Theorem A's affine structure, dimension m + 1 ≥ 1. The global defs resultBHopfGen and resultBHopfGroup are harmless. They are plain defs, with no @[instance] and no @[simp], and resultB-prefixed. projOfAff is a local instance confined to `section Hopf`, and every instance on the quotient is a haveI/letI.

findings.what: The docstring of resultB_t2Space_of_isCoveringMap places lean-gx's t2Space_of_isCoveringMap in `GX/Topology/Spread.lean`. It is at `GX/Branched/Universality.lean:249`, as the module SCOPE (l.79–80) and the REPORT correctly say.

resultB_nonVacuite_dim_zero is the only witness that instantiates UniversalCover itself, and its V is S(0), which is two points and not connected. It therefore lies outside the paper's « variété » and outside ResultBProjPrinted's hypotheses, and it is valid only through the disclosed component reading. Neither its docstring nor the REPORT says so. resultB_revetementUniversel_sphere's docstring (« The compact manifolds of the statement exist in every dimension … S(n) … a compact Hausdorff locally projective manifold ») overstates the case for n = 0 in the same way. The non-degenerate Hopf witness has a connected V but goes through the general-covering form. This is adequate, as argued under checks.non_vacuity, but should be said where the witnesses are.
findings.fix: At graduation, add to l.517 and to the REPORT/curation note that S(0) is disconnected, so W is the cover of x's component (UniversalCoverRow's convention). Add « (n ≥ 1 for a connected one) » to l.437. Optionally, T-bz-result-b can transport the Hopf shell to UniversalCover through UniversalCover.exists_homeomorph_of_simplyConnected.
